# LetMe v3.0.1 - Table of Contents

> Authorization library with a DSL and introspection

## Pages

- [LetMe](https://let-me.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://let-me.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- Cheatsheets
  - [Rules and Checks](https://let-me.hexdocs.pm/rules.md)

## Modules

- [LetMe](https://let-me.hexdocs.pm/LetMe.md): LetMe is a library for defining and evaluating authorization rules and
handling query scopes and field redactions.
- [LetMe.Policy](https://let-me.hexdocs.pm/LetMe.Policy.md): This module defines a DSL for authorization rules and compiles these rules
to authorization and introspection functions.
- [LetMe.Schema](https://let-me.hexdocs.pm/LetMe.Schema.md): Defines a behaviour with callbacks for scoping and redactions.

- Structs
  - [LetMe.Rule](https://let-me.hexdocs.pm/LetMe.Rule.md): A struct for an authorization rule.

- Exceptions
  - [LetMe.UnauthorizedError](https://let-me.hexdocs.pm/LetMe.UnauthorizedError.md): Raised by `c:LetMe.Policy.authorize!/4` if a request is unauthorized.
